text:
nate: quick follow-up on the quant observability work. small proposal: add per-customer opt-out + hashed-sample-id pattern so we can calibrate without leaking prompts.
sara: agree. hashed ids + a separate encrypted blob store for raw payloads with TTL sounds right. how do we toggle opt-out? header or per-tenant config?
omar: per-tenant config is authoritative; header 'x-quant-observe:1' can opt-in only if tenant allows. this avoids accidental data flow.
mei: sampling rates: suggest 0.2% global, 2% for internal trials, and 10% for canaries. make adjustable per-tenant and per-model.
nate: good. also propose we store only minimal metadata for every event: sample_hash, quant_profile, proxy_score, normalized_score, model_tag. raw payload lives only if tenant consents.
sara: one more: calibration harness should run async gold-runs (FP16 baseline) on a separate low-priority queue. avoid affecting latency.
omar: implementation: runtime emits proxy event; a sampler forwards events to calibration queue. scheduler handles gold-run and writes results back to calibration table.
ops-bot: ops: created calibration queue 'calib-lowpri' and set default GPU quota 5% :gear:
mei: security note: raw payload blobs encrypted with customer-specific KMS keys where available. default use platform KMS. enforce TTL and strict ACLs.
nate: UX: dashboard needs two views: realtime proxy heatmap and weekly calibration scatter with proxy vs gold delta. thresholds editable per-model.
sara: action items: 1) nate to write schema + header rules 2) mei to draft KMS/TTL/access controls 3) omar to add sampler + queue wiring 4) sara to mock dashboard.
mei: sounds good. will also add a short section on PII redaction heuristics for payloads.
nate: thanks, will push schema draft to #rfc-quant by EOD and schedule a 30m sync if folks want to walk it through. :thumbsup:
